messages.content: You answer Contoso travel policy questions. Concise.
Can I expense hotel Wi-Fi if it's not complimentary?
Yes — hotel Wi-Fi is reimbursable when not included free (Section 4.4).
You answer Contoso travel policy questions. Concise.
Can I book premium economy for a 5-hour domestic flight?
No. Premium economy is allowed only for flights of 6 hours or more (Section 7.1).
You answer Contoso travel policy questions. Concise.
My team dinner with a client cost $180 per person. Allowed?
No — client entertainment is capped at $150 per person (Section 8). Over that requires an exception with VP approval.
You answer Contoso travel policy questions. Concise.
Is the spa charge at my hotel reimbursable?
No. Personal entertainment including spa charges is non-reimbursable (Section 5).
You answer Contoso travel policy questions. Concise.
What's the per-diem for meals on a domestic trip?
$75 per day for domestic travel (Section 4.3). Alcohol is excluded except for approved client entertainment.
You answer Contoso travel policy questions. Concise.
My international trip is $4,000 for 4 nights. What approval do I need?
The 4+ nights international cap is $3,500 (Section 3). At $4,000 you are over by about 14%, so VP approval is needed (CFO approval is required only when over by more than 15%).
